pdf.published: The PDF is published, and marketing and sales were notified
pdf.note: The PDF and the slide are made automatically in the Places design: the cover and the table from the unit's data, the photos from the Pic & Info folder (the first photo is the building, the rest are inside shots). Nobody edits them by hand: any change to the data or photos shows in them right away, and the unit waits for Manar's Confirm again. The unit isn't shown to sales until it's confirmed.

photos.note: These photos are seen from the Pic & Info column in the sheet and from the unit's page, and the PDF and slide are made from them (the first photo is the cover). The first upload's time is recorded and counts toward «Photos uploaded within 24 hours».

upload.counts: With this choice: {marked} rows will be marked as duplicates ({by}{all, select, true { · all must match} other {}}) of existing rows or each other · and if you choose «Leave out», only {skip} are left out (the first row of each repeat goes in). An owner with the same name and another number or unit is not a duplicate unless you pick the name alone.

notActive.managerNote: Manar is responsible for these sheets. Any new sheet is merged with the existing one without duplicates, and any number already in the main inventory raises an Alarm for her to decide its status.
notActive.teamNote: These are the numbers Manar sent you. Call each number and classify it: No Answer, Not True (with the reason), or Done (and enter the unit's data and photos).
notActive.columnsHint: These columns come from the sheet itself until the client sends the CFC sheet's columns.
notActive.savedNotTrue: Saved as Not True with the Feedback
notActive.savedMatched: Status set · the row stays in the sheet
notActive.pendingManager: With Marwa or not sent yet

files.note: Every Not Active sheet has a file with its name, and files are grouped in folders. Make a new file, name it, and upload the sheet straight into it; any duplicates in the data show and can be filtered.
files.mineNote: These are the files with numbers Manar sent you. Open a file and classify each number.
files.search: Search by file or folder name
files.none: No files yet · make a new file and upload the sheet into it
files.inNote: Upload the sheet straight into this file: every row goes in, and rows that repeat a value in the columns below are marked in red and can be filtered. Any number already in the main inventory sends you an Alarm to set its status.
files.uploadMore: Upload another sheet into the file (Excel / CSV)
